description: AI Hangout Intake -> Perplexity -> Grok -> Gemini -> Claude -> Codex -> AI Hangout Banking. Every hop must pay rent. Truth first. Real goal second. Usefulness third.
core_rule: Every hop must pay rent. Truth first. Real goal second. Usefulness third. No hallucinated files, services, configs, logs, tasks, or completed work.

shared_rules.hlm_format: Highest Leverage Move: [one clear, actionable sentence]
shared_rules.hangout_starts_cycle: AI Hangout selects work from chat/todo
shared_rules.hangout_ends_cycle: AI Hangout banks HLMs, assigns tasks, updates todo/notes

stages.task: Read the current chat, todo/notes board, HLM tracker, recent agent outputs, and unresolved open loops. Pick the strongest concrete work item for this cycle. Do not solve it yet. Package the context for Perplexity.

next_agent_routing.name: Perplexity
next_agent_routing.reason: AI Hangout selected the work item; Perplexity must ground it in facts.
next_agent_routing.instruction: Research and verify the selected work item. Separate facts, uncertainties, and claims needing local verification.
next_agent_routing.context: Original chat request + selected work item + todo/HLM context + known files/evidence.

stages.task: Research and ground the selected work item. Use recent, primary, high-signal sources when external facts matter. Kill weak or outdated claims. Do not recommend execution until the evidence base is clear.

next_agent_routing.name: Grok
next_agent_routing.reason: Perplexity grounded the facts; Grok must attack assumptions and find the real leverage.
next_agent_routing.instruction: Stress-test the research, invert the plan, surface hidden risks, and identify the strongest leverage point.
next_agent_routing.context: Original request + AI Hangout intake + Perplexity findings/sources/uncertainties.

stages.task: Stress-test the research. Invert the plan. Surface false assumptions, hidden risks, second-order effects, and leverage points. Decide whether this is real execution work or process drift.

next_agent_routing.name: Gemini
next_agent_routing.reason: Grok identified what matters; Gemini must verify what exists in reality.
next_agent_routing.instruction: Map files, services, docs, configs, logs, runtime checks, and missing evidence. Do not execute.
next_agent_routing.context: Original request + AI Hangout intake + Perplexity facts + Grok risks/HLM.

stages.task: Verify what exists in chat, repo, services, docs, configs, boards, logs, and runtime state. Output evidence and gaps. Do not design or execute yet.

next_agent_routing.name: Claude
next_agent_routing.reason: Gemini mapped reality; Claude must judge sequence, architecture, and risk.
next_agent_routing.instruction: Produce the risk-ranked recommendation, safest sequence, do-not-touch list, and success criteria.
next_agent_routing.context: Original request + all prior outputs + Gemini evidence/file manifest.

stages.task: Use Gemini's evidence to judge architecture, sequencing, risk, and failure modes. Define what must not be touched yet. Produce the safest executable path.

next_agent_routing.name: Codex
next_agent_routing.reason: Claude defined the safe path; Codex must convert it into executable commands or scoped patches.
next_agent_routing.instruction: Inspect before editing, make only justified scoped changes, and verify with proof.
next_agent_routing.context: Original request + all prior outputs + Gemini evidence + Claude risk plan.

stages.task: Convert the verified plan into commands, patches, or implementation steps. Inspect before editing. Keep changes scoped. Verify with real proof. Do not claim success without evidence.

next_agent_routing.name: AI Hangout
next_agent_routing.reason: Codex produced the execution path/proof; AI Hangout must merge, bank, and assign final work.
next_agent_routing.instruction: Synthesize without inventing facts. Bank HLMs, update todo/notes, assign owners, and emit the next concrete action.
next_agent_routing.context: Original request + full cycle outputs + execution plan/proof/open loops.

stages.task: Merge all outputs without inventing facts. Bank every HLM. Update todo/notes. Assign work across lanes. Emit one final recommended action with owner and first step.

next_agent_routing.name: AI Hangout
next_agent_routing.role: Context Intake / Work Selector for next cycle
next_agent_routing.reason: The cycle is complete; AI Hangout should pull the next work item from live chat/todo.
next_agent_routing.instruction: Start the next cycle only after banking this cycle's HLMs, todo updates, and open loops.
next_agent_routing.context: Final merged verdict + todo updates + banked HLMs + unresolved blockers.
